Please fill out the following information:

- Plugin name:
- Plugin description: 
- Plugin repository link
- Version codes supported by your plugin:
- Plugin ID: 

Any other information you  think is relevant to reviwers:


If you don't know how to fill out this form please visit https://rosepen-studios.gitbook.io/tasker/guides/guides/11.-publishing

Please not that for security and privacy reasons, we do not accept plugins that are not open-source or that are hosted on private repositories. We also review each submission's source code to ensure that it does not contain any malicious code or violate any privacy policies. If your plugin is accepted, it will be added to the Tasker Plugin Store and made available for users to download and install. Should your plugin be rejected, we will provide feedback on the reasons for rejection and any necessary changes that need to be made before resubmission. If malicious code is found in your plugin, we will remove it from the store/reject it and may take further action, including reporting the plugin to GitHub and/or other relevant authorities. You can at any point remove your plugin from the store by creating a new issue in this repository using the "Plugin Removal" template. Please provide the plugin's name and ID, and we will remove it from the store.
